verdict_meaning: The instrument software subtracted a baseline before export. That weakens LinRegPCR's per-well efficiency, because it cannot see each well's own baseline. Re-export the raw fluorescence to restore it: in CFX Manager or Maestro choose 'No Baseline Subtraction' before exporting; from QuantStudio export Rn, not Delta Rn.
